newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Deere cut to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Deere cut to outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded Deere & Co to outperform from buy.
-- Said stock price is near objective and company's increased spending for growth initiative limits ability to raise near-term earnings estimates.
-- Earnings estimates remain at $3.70-$3.90 per share for 1997 and $3.90-$4.30 for 1998 with target price "in mid-high $40's."
-- Said top pick in machinery group remains Case Corp, rated a buy.
-- Deere rose 1/8 to 43-5/8. Case rose 3/4 to 53-1/2.
